entities.text: Sher Mohammed Khan vs State Of Telangana
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text:
1
 The Honourable Sri Justice E. V. Venugopal
 Writ Petition No.36043 Of 2015
O R D E R:

The present Writ Petition is filed under Article 226 of Constitution of India seeking the following relief/s:-
"... to issue a Writ , Order or Direction more particularly in the nature of Certiorari and consequently quash the complaint and investigation in FIR No.189 of 2015 dated 21.03.2015 pending on the file of PS Mailardevpally and pass such other order or orders ..."
2.
It is the case of the petitioners that the petitioner No.1 has purchased plot No.833, admeasuring 462 square yards in survey No.134/20 from D.Narayana under registered sale deed dated 31.03.2006.
The said D.Narayana purchased the said plot from Shastripuram Co-operative Housing Building Society Limited through registered sale deed dated 25.07.1981.

entities.text: Shastripuram Co-operative Housing Building Society Limited
entities.label: ORG

sentences.text: Thereafter, petitioner No.1 has sold the said property to petitioner No.2 through an agreement of sale-cum-General Power of Attorney vide document dated 26.09.2006.
Subsequently, petitioner No.2 has sold the said property to Khatija Begum through registered sale deed dated 23.09.2006.

Respondent No.3, in order to extract money from the petitioners, has given a false complaint stating that petitioner Nos.1 and 2 and others colluded with each other and created forged documents and converted the civil disputes into criminal one.

Respondent No.2-Sub Inspector of Police, Mailardevpally Police Station, has registered the said complaint as a case in Crime No. 189 of 2015 for the offences punishable under Sections 420, 468 and 471 of I.P.C. Hence, the present writ petition is filed seeking to quash the said crime.

entities.text: Sub Inspector of Police, Mailardevpally Police Station
entities.label: RESPONDENT

sentences.text: 3. Mr. Sai Ram, learned Assistant Government Pleader, representing, learned Government Pleader for Home, submits that the relief sought for in the writ petition does not survive for adjudication as the investigation is completed and charge sheet is filed and the same was numbered as C.C.No.740 of 2016.
4. Recording the submission made by the learned Assistant Government Pleader, this Writ Petition is dismissed as infructuous.
Miscellaneous Petitions, pending if any, shall stand closed.
E.V. VENUGOPAL, J Date: 19.06.2023 ESP THE HON'BLE SRI Sher Mohammed Khan vs State Of Telangana on 19 June, 2023
